name: ib-butcher-epson-print-relay
description: TCP bridge: HTTPS (via tunnel) -> Epson TM-T88VII port 9100

notes.PRINTER_IP: Override via env var, default 192.168.4.155 (current Woodbury Epson DHCP IP as of 8/21/2026 — verify this hasn't changed)
notes.PRINTER_PORT: Override via env var, default 9100 (Epson raw ESC/POS socket port)
notes.RELAY_SHARED_SECRET: Set this to a random string and configure the same value in Vercel's EPSON_RELAY_SECRET env var — since the tunnel URL is technically public, this prevents randoms from printing to your receipt printer.
